getCulturesSemantics.currentHierarchy: A deferred GetCultureHierarchy(cultureInfo) sequence is the initial culturesToLoad; it is not first materialized or globally deduplicated.
getCulturesSemantics.hierarchyIteration: The iterator excludes the invariant singleton and null, yields the current CultureInfo.Name, checks culture == culture.Parent to break on the same-reference parent, then advances to culture.Parent. It preserves the producer's child-to-parent traversal.
getCulturesSemantics.uiGate: cultureInfo != uiCultureInfo compares CultureInfo references, not name strings or CultureInfo.Equals. The same object skips the UI loop. A null UI value supplies an empty hierarchy. Distinct objects are not presumed to have distinct names.
getCulturesSemantics.membership: For each yielded UI name, Contains tests the accumulated string sequence with default string equality. The common BCL witnesses show EqualityComparer<string>.Default and ordinal, case-sensitive string Equals semantics, not culture-sensitive name matching.
getCulturesSemantics.order: Previously unseen UI names are logically appended after all current-culture names, in UI child-to-parent order. At the first UI name already present, the product breaks out of the UI loop. It does not continue to test every remaining ancestor.
getCulturesSemantics.deduplication: Membership avoids appending an already-present UI name and triggers the first-common-name break. It does not remove any duplicate Names supplied within the initial current-culture hierarchy or perform a general whole-sequence Distinct operation.
getCulturesSemantics.deferral: GetCultureHierarchy is a yield iterator. The common Append source retains its original source and returns append iterators without eagerly enumerating the hierarchy. Membership requests can enumerate it. GetCultures finally materializes ToArray before returning; resource-loading interop receives that array, not the deferred hierarchy.
getCulturesSemantics.exceptionAndSideEffectTiming: Name/Parent accesses occur when hierarchy iterators advance, not when the iterator object is obtained. Current/UI values are read before GetCultures is called. Contains can observe the current hierarchy while the UI loop is in progress; final materialization occurs before the interop call. There is no catch in GetCultures that suppresses getter/enumerator/materialization failures. This is not a promise of exact getter/comparison counts or arbitrary overridden-member behavior.
getCulturesSemantics.dispatchBoundary: The common Contains source checks ICollection and can dispatch Iterator<T>.Contains. Its optimized append-iterator partial implementation and the selected role runtime are not captured. Repeated membership requests are evident, but no exact number/order of source traversals, comparisons, allocations or selected-runtime cost is asserted.
